title: Suggestions & Decisions
description: Proposals for improving decision-making and for discovering missing information. Each row is a proposal, not a finding or a legal conclusion: a reviewer chooses a path before anything is implemented.

rows.label: Adopt one written, neutral annual-increase policy for each eligible unit
rows.value: Use an identical written standard (eligibility, anniversary date, rate, calculation) applied to each eligible unit rather than ad hoc decisions.
rows.notes: No official source requires raising both units, but identical neutral criteria reduce disparate-treatment risk. Proposed review decision: approve a single neutral policy, or document why one unit differs, before serving any notice.

rows.label: Make the Notice Worksheet a standing pre-notice gate
rows.value: Require every notice to clear the worksheet gates (coverage, license on the effective date, anniversary, rate, banking, petitions, retaliation) and record service.
rows.notes: Each gate is checkable against the linked official page. Proposed review decision: adopt the worksheet as the standard pre-notice checklist for both units.

rows.label: Add an annual rate-in-force check every March 1
rows.value: Before serving a notice, confirm the allowable percentage in effect on the increase date and record the rate page date used.
rows.notes: The notice must use the rate in effect on the increase date, not the notice date, and the schedule changes each March 1. Proposed review decision: calendar a March 1 rate check and file the dated page copy.

rows.label: Add a decision log recording the chosen path, sources and dates
rows.value: For each decision, record the path chosen, the official sources relied on, the date and the decision-maker.
rows.notes: The site already publishes this for flags and the ledger; the two units deserve the same record. Project-record source: it is not a government legal source. Proposed review decision: adopt a one-page decision log for both units.

rows.label: Keep unimplemented suggestions visually distinct with a proposed badge
rows.value: Treat every suggestion row as proposed, not verified, so a reviewer can see what is a decision to make rather than a finding.
rows.notes: This page is a review-only section; nothing here is implemented or asserted as law. Proposed review decision: keep the Suggestions page as a review gate, not as findings.

rows.label: Show any fee recovery as a separate fee line, never inside a rent increase
rows.value: If recovering the 50% Rent Board Fee ($29.50 per dwelling unit for 2026-2027), bill it as a fee recovery with its own line item and wording.
rows.notes: The recovery is a fee, not rent, and penalties may not be recovered. Proposed review decision: if recovering, present it separately and keep the deposit-interest or billing method compliant.

sections.title: Information discovery - close the gaps before deciding

rows.label: Confirm a current Rent Increase License for both units in the Rent Board Portal
rows.value: Log in to the Rent Board Portal, check license status by address or APN, and record the result and date for each unit.
rows.notes: Information discovery. Closes the license gap (T03-F05): no increase should be treated as effective until this is confirmed. Proposed review decision: check both units and record the date.

rows.label: Reconstruct the rent-increase and notice history for both units
rows.value: Assemble the date and amount of every increase and notice for each unit so banked eligibility can be tested.
rows.notes: No banked amount may be inferred without history; banking requires at least 24 full months without any increase. Proposed review decision: gather the history and recompute banked percentages only if the 24-month fact is documented.

rows.label: Confirm whether the April 1, 2026 Unit 1 continuation started a new tenancy and whether a 6.14 notice was served
rows.value: Obtain the lease or tenancy facts and any Section 6.14 notice for the occupant added April 1, 2026.
rows.notes: Information discovery. Closes the vacancy-decontrol gap (T03-F04, F28); no market-rate reset is recommended until these facts exist. Proposed review decision: obtain the documents before any reset is considered.

rows.label: Ask the Rent Board whether an unlicensed notice can be cured and confirm the fee/licence timing for this property
rows.value: If any notice has already been served without a license, ask the Rent Board how it is treated; also confirm the fee referral timing (F38) for this property.
rows.notes: Resolves the referral-timing discrepancy inside one SF.gov page and any already-served notice. The Rent Board gives information and referral, not legal advice. Proposed review decision: ask and record the answer.

rows.label: Re-check File 261020 committee status before any banked or capital-improvement increase
rows.value: Immediately before relying on any banked or capital-improvement increase, re-check the Legistar status and the Rent Board notice.
rows.notes: The proposal is not enacted and its wording is internally inconsistent (F46, F47). Proposed review decision: re-check status and record the date before serving any stacked increase.

rows.label: Decide how to handle the historical identifier exposure outside git history
rows.value: Review F44: raw tenant identifiers remain reachable in this public repository's git history and pull-request diffs; only the owner can remediate it.
rows.notes: Owner-actionable privacy item; it is not fixed by any site change. Proposed review decision: choose to purge/rotate or to accept and document the residual risk.
